roles.query: WITH category AS (SELECT skill_category, COUNT(*) AS total_skills, SUM(CASE WHEN proficiency_level = N'เชี่ยวชาญ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expert_count FROM skills GROUP BY skill_category) SELECT skill_category, total_skills, expert_count FROM category UNION ALL SELECT N'รวมทั้งหมด' AS skill_category, SUM(total_skills) AS total_skills, SUM(expert_count) AS expert_count FROM category ORDER BY skill_category

roles.query: WITH s AS (SELECT e.emp_length, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, AVG(l.funded_amnt) AS avg_funded_amnt, AVG(l.int_rate) * 100 AS avg_int_rate_pct, AVG(l.dti) AS avg_dti FROM loans_fact l JOIN emp_length_dim e ON l.emp_length_id=e.emp_length_id GROUP BY e.emp_length), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_funded_amnt DESC, emp_length) AS highest, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_funded_amnt ASC, emp_length) AS lowest_overall FROM s), n AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY avg_funded_amnt ASC, emp_length) AS lowest_non_na FROM s WHERE emp_length <> 'N/A'), extrema AS (SELECT 'highest' AS extreme_type, emp_length, loan_count, avg_funded_amnt, avg_int_rate_pct, avg_dti, 1 AS sort_order FROM r WHERE highest=1 UNION ALL SELECT 'lowest_overall', emp_length, loan_count, avg_funded_amnt, avg_int_rate_pct, avg_dti, 2 FROM r WHERE lowest_overall=1 UNION ALL SELECT 'lowest_non_na', emp_length, loan_count, avg_funded_amnt, avg_int_rate_pct, avg_dti, 3 FROM n WHERE lowest_non_na=1) SELECT extreme_type, emp_length, loan_count, CAST(avg_funded_amnt AS decimal(20,6)) AS avg_funded_amnt, CAST(avg_int_rate_pct AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_int_rate_pct, CAST(avg_dti AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_dti FROM extrema ORDER BY sort_order
